prompt:
Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: production animation sprite atlas with real alpha transparency.
Image 1 is ONLY an identity/style reference. Recreate the SAME office fox: orange fluffy fur, white cheeks/chest/tail tip, large dark round glasses, white short sleeve office shirt, navy tie, dark charcoal trousers, black dress shoes, dark wristwatch and small employee ID badge. Same 3D animated film render and proportions as reference. No text or logos on badge.
Create ONE precisely arranged atlas of EIGHT consecutive animation keyframes, 4 columns x 2 rows, row-major reading order. Canvas landscape 3072 x 2048 pixels if possible. Each cell equally sized, with transparent empty gutter and full character visible in every cell. No labels, grid lines, backgrounds or ground shadows. ACTUAL TRANSPARENT ALPHA background everywhere outside the fox, including between arms and body.
Animation: friendly office hello wave, seamlessly looping. Fox stands at a fixed three-quarter frontal angle, head and torso stable and feet at identical baseline in every frame. One arm raised at shoulder/head level, palm open toward viewer. Frame1 hand tilted inward, frame2 midway, frame3 hand tilted outward, frame4 outer maximum, frame5 return midway, frame6 inward maximum, frame7 midway, frame8 just before frame1. Natural subtle elbow/wrist changes only, cheerful small closed-mouth smile; keep eye shape and glasses stable. The other arm relaxed beside body. White fluffy tail visible on same side throughout. Preserve identical character size and camera in every cell. Give each fox 12% cell padding on every side, never touch edges. Every cell contains exactly ONE complete fox, no partial neighboring characters. It must be usable as eight distinct frames of ONE continuous waving motion. Do not produce eight unrelated poses. No motion blur, no baked checkerboard.
